SLComposeServiceViewController.doc: A view controller that you present from your share app extension, allowing the user to compose social media posts.

SLRequest.doc: An object that you use to assemble an HTTP request for communicating with a social media service.

SLRequestMethod.doc: Indicates the request method used in the request.

SLRequestMethodGET.doc: Requests information from the specified resource.

SLRequestMethodPUT.doc: Uses a PUT request to submit the data.

-cancel.doc: Starts the animated dismissal of the compose view.

-configurationItems.doc: Returns configuration items to display in the compose view.

-didSelectCancel.doc: Sent to the compose view after the cancel animation finishes.

-didSelectPost.doc: Sent to the compose view after the post animation finishes.

-isContentValid.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the current content and attachments are valid.

-loadPreviewView.doc: Loads a view that displays a preview of the attachments in the extension context.

-popConfigurationViewController.doc: Dismisses the current configuration view controller.

-presentationAnimationDidFinish.doc: Tells the compose view controller that the presentation animation is finished.

-pushConfigurationViewController:.doc: Presents a configuration view controller that lets the user configure the post.

-reloadConfigurationItems.doc: Reloads the list of configuration items.

-validateContent.doc: Performs validation of the current content and updates the state of the Post button, if appropriate.

+requestForServiceType:requestMethod:URL.doc: Initializes a newly created request object with the specified properties.

-addMultipartData:withName:type:.doc: Specifies a named multipart POST body for this request.

-addMultipartData:withName:type:filename.doc: Specifies a named multipart POST body for this request.

-performRequestWithHandler:.doc: Performs an asynchronous request and calls the specified handler when done.

-preparedURLRequest.doc: Returns an authorized URL request that can be sent using an NSURLConnection object.

autoCompletionViewController.doc: The view controller that manages an autocompletion view for suggesting common text completions while users type.

charactersRemaining.doc: The number of characters remaining in a custom character limit.

contentText.doc: A string that represents the text which the user entered into the compose view’s text view.

placeholder.doc: A string that’s displayed in the compose view’s text view when the text view is empty.

textView.doc: The editable text view in the compose view.

URL.doc: The destination URL for this request.

account.doc: Account information used to authenticate the request.

requestMethod.doc: The method to use for this request.
